The test image shows a green mango stem with leaves that have been partially consumed, leaving only triangular stubs/midribs — a hallmark of weevil feeding damage. The Cutting_Weevil reference collage is a near-identical match (same plant structure, same blue background, same pattern of partially eaten leaves with only the basal triangular portions remaining). Anthracnose and Die_Back show entirely different symptom patterns (lesions on intact leaves vs. complete brown leaf desiccation).
